cohort: This study included 280 nulliparous women with uncomplicated singleton pregnancies who went past their estimated date of delivery, divided into an induction of labor group (n=150) and an expectant management group (n=130).
finding: Induction of labor after the estimated date of delivery in nulliparous women with uncomplicated pregnancies resulted in a lower cesarean section rate and fewer maternal and perinatal complications compared to expectant management.
